_comment: Deterministic retrieval probes — NO LLM. Each probe is a benchmark task phrased as 'when an agent searches/queries for X, does codegraph surface the right knowledge?'. 'search' probes run cg.searchNodes (the exact path codegraph_search wraps) and assert the expected node appears (within `limit`, or at rank #1 when `expectTop`). 'edge' probes read the SQLite graph directly and assert the synthesized/resolved edges exist. The improved build should pass all; the original build (no doc indexing) fails the knowledge probes — that gap IS the result.

probes.desc: Searching a skill's capability surfaces its SKILL.md (frontmatter description is searchable).
The 'Use when…' trigger words route to the skill (trigger is folded into the searchable docstring).
A slash command is found and its argument-hint is folded into the searchable docstring.
On a term shared by an agent-memory file and an ordinary doc, the memory file ranks first.
A binary asset is findable by name, and its document records that content is NOT indexed.
SKILL.md is linked to its indexed bundle siblings (reference doc + helper script).
A README image link resolves to the asset's file node (doc → asset).
A doc that names a source file/symbol links to the code (doc → code).
